key_changes: Replaced manual filter parameter extraction with FilterConfig utility
Replaced manual queryset filtering logic with apply_list_filters utility
Replaced manual pagination with apply_list_filters pagination handling
Introduced apply_date_range_filter for date range handling
Simplified context variable assignment by using utility return values

patterns_discovered.description: Code was refactored to use FilterConfig and apply_list_filters utilities instead of manual filter processing
patterns_discovered.benefit: Reduces code duplication, improves maintainability, standardizes filtering across views

patterns_discovered.description: Date range filtering is handled by a separate apply_date_range_filter function distinct from general field filters
patterns_discovered.benefit: Allows specialized date handling logic without cluttering general filter configuration

patterns_discovered.description: Pagination logic moved from manual Paginator usage to apply_list_filters utility
patterns_discovered.benefit: Consistent pagination behavior across multiple views, easier to modify pagination defaults

patterns_discovered.description: Filters defined declaratively as FilterConfig objects with param_name, filter_type, and filter_kwargs
patterns_discovered.benefit: Clear, maintainable filter specifications that are easily extensible

gotchas_discovered.description: apply_date_range_filter returns a tuple (queryset, date_values) while apply_list_filters returns a dict with 'queryset' and 'filter_values' keys
gotchas_discovered.impact: Requires different handling patterns; developers must understand each utility's return structure
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Document utility return types clearly; consider standardizing return structures across all filter utilities

gotchas_discovered.description: The filter_kwargs uses '{value}' as a placeholder that gets substituted with actual parameter values
gotchas_discovered.impact: Non-obvious template substitution requires knowledge of the apply_list_filters implementation
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Add inline comments explaining the templating mechanism or use more explicit placeholder syntax

gotchas_discovered.description: filter_values returned from apply_list_filters uses .get() with defaults, while date_values are directly accessed
gotchas_discovered.impact: Inconsistent error handling patterns between different filter types
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Standardize how filter values are accessed in context, ensure consistent fallback behavior

approach_outcome.description: Successfully refactored bin_history view to use apply_list_filters and apply_date_range_filter utilities
key_accomplishments: Replaced manual pagination with utility-based pagination
Maintained all original functionality including statistics calculation
Preserved context variable passing to template

recommendations.recommendation: Standardize return types across all filter utility functions (apply_list_filters, apply_date_range_filter, etc.) to use consistent dict-based structures with clearly defined keys
recommendations.rationale: Current mixed return patterns (tuple vs dict) create cognitive load and increase error potential

recommendations.recommendation: Document the FilterConfig.filter_kwargs templating mechanism with examples showing how '{value}' placeholder substitution works
recommendations.rationale: The placeholder substitution is non-obvious and could lead to incorrect filter configurations

recommendations.recommendation: Consider moving the filters definition to a module-level constant or class attribute if this pattern is reused across multiple views
recommendations.rationale: Would improve maintainability and allow for easier testing of filter configurations

recommendations.recommendation: Add integration tests verifying that all filter combinations work correctly (type filter + date range, pagination with filters, etc.)
recommendations.rationale: Refactoring consolidated multiple filter types; comprehensive tests ensure edge cases are handled

recommendations.recommendation: Verify that select_related('material', 'batch', 'performed_by') continues to be optimal after filter application changes
recommendations.rationale: Ensure utility functions don't inadvertently cause additional queries
